purpose: Codex-authored semantic repair guidance for the LocalLLM Day Runner. Entries never contain executable edits, commands, or line-level instructions.

repairs.title: Windows temporary-directory access conflict
repairs.cause: A benchmark fixture creates disposable files in a shared Windows temporary location where an interrupted process can retain access.
repairs.investigation: Reproduce the isolated benchmark test and confirm the access-denied signature without changing benchmark data.
repairs.resolution_logic: Give the test a test-owned disposable fixture location with reliable creation and cleanup; preserve all benchmark assertions and data contracts.
repairs.verification: Rerun the isolated benchmark test, then the deterministic regression suite.

repairs.title: Preflight non-repository fixture isolation
repairs.cause: The preflight test needs a writable folder outside the repository. A shared temporary folder can remain locked, while an in-repository folder fails the test's Git-state contract.
repairs.investigation: Run the preflight test alone and inspect the disposable fixture's named Git-state check before and after the test initializes Git.
repairs.resolution_logic: Use a test-owned writable scratch parent outside the repository, preserve the initial non-repository condition, and keep the test's assertions intact.
repairs.verification: Rerun the preflight test in isolation, then the deterministic regression suite.

repairs.title: Preflight failure requiring evidence-based classification
repairs.cause: The isolated preflight test failed, but its captured trace does not prove that the temporary-fixture condition is the cause.
repairs.investigation: Preserve the bounded stderr excerpt, reproduce only preflight, and identify the failing assertion or external command before selecting a more specific catalog entry.
repairs.resolution_logic: Do not reuse a temporary-directory repair solely because the failed work item is preflight. Propose a change only when the actual trace and supplied source establish a specific cause; otherwise return a handoff for Codex investigation.
repairs.verification: Rerun the isolated preflight test after the specific cause is addressed, then the deterministic regression suite.

repairs.title: Background PowerShell JSON encoding mismatch
repairs.cause: The preflight test passes interactively but its pwsh JSON output is decoded as non-UTF-8 when the dashboard is launched from a hidden Windows PowerShell host.
repairs.investigation: Compare the captured UnicodeDecodeError with an isolated preflight run under the same launcher, then confirm the target test and its three-check sequence pass outside the hidden host.
repairs.resolution_logic: Fix the runner launch environment so the server and its child PowerShell JSON processes use UTF-8. Preserve strict JSON decoding and all preflight assertions; do not hide decoding errors.
repairs.verification: Restart the dashboard, run Smoke, confirm preflight exits zero, then run the deterministic regression suite.

repairs.title: Run-profile selection drift
repairs.cause: A negative test selects a run profile by position even though the configured profile order may change.
repairs.investigation: Compare configured profile identifiers with the profile selected by the negative test.
repairs.resolution_logic: Bind the test to the profile's stable semantic identifier rather than a positional assumption; do not weaken the negative-test expectation.
repairs.verification: Rerun experiment-config tests, then the deterministic regression suite.

repairs.title: Decision run terminal-manifest ordering
repairs.cause: A completed LocalLLM run can leave a manifest in an inconsistent terminal state when final output writes occur after the manifest is marked complete.
repairs.investigation: Confirm all planned case and metric records exist, then inspect whether summary and results outputs were written before the terminal manifest update.
repairs.resolution_logic: Ask LocalLLM for a bounded finalization proposal. Keep the manifest non-terminal until summary and results writes succeed; validate the proposal with a write-failure focused test before implementation.
repairs.verification: Run the focused finalization test, then validate the preserved run artifact without starting a new inference.

repairs.title: DAGB baseline fingerprint drift
repairs.cause: A versioned benchmark configuration records a SHA256 that no longer matches its immutable baseline file.
repairs.investigation: Measure the named baseline file SHA256 deterministically and compare it with the versioned configuration before proposing any change.
repairs.resolution_logic: Ask LocalLLM to propose an exact replacement only after the measured SHA256 is supplied. Preserve all other experiment conditions and validate with the version-specific focused test.
repairs.verification: Run the benchmark version's focused configuration tests, then continue the deterministic regression.
